About Nava deep M

NM

Hello! I am Nava deep M, currently pursuing my First-Year Diploma at AANM and VVRSR. Stepping into technical education has opened up exciting opportunities to learn how real-world systems work, collaborate with classmates, and build strong problem-solving habits.

Outside of lectures and lab sessions, I believe that creativity fuels focus. Whether I am practicing vocals and singing my favorite songs or unwinding by watching movies across different genres, I enjoy activities that inspire imagination, rhythm, and fresh perspectives.
